name: Prarthana Thombare
bio:
Career Overview: Prarthana Thombare is an active Indian tennis player, specializing in doubles, with a strong presence on the ITF circuit and international stage.

Playing Style: Known for her smart net play and doubles instincts, she thrives on hard courts and clay.

Career-High WTA Singles Ranking: #335 (August 25, 2014)
Career-High WTA Doubles Ranking: #125 (October 16, 2017)

Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam main draw; focuses on doubles.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 3 ITF singles titles and 29 ITF doubles titles.
  • Earned a bronze medal in women’s doubles at the 2014 Asian Games with Sania Mirza.
  • Won the WTA 125K doubles title in Mumbai (2024) with Arianne Hartono.

Other Highlights:
  • Competed at the 2016 Rio Olympics in doubles with Sania Mirza, reaching the second round.
  • A regular in Billie Jean King Cup for India, with a win-loss record of 17–10 as of June 2024.

Prarthana remains a vital doubles contributor to Indian tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
